data.long_meaning: Derived from Old Norse 'Freydar' meaning 'lord, master' and 'son of'. Historically, the name was borne by various European rulers. In Christianity, St. Frederick is a popular saint. The name Frederiksen carries the meaning “Peaceful ruler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Frederiksen usually hope their child will grow to embody peaceful ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Frederiksen total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
data.cultural_impact: The name Frederiksen has roots in Norse culture, signifying the name of 'lord' or 'master' in Old Norse. Historically, individuals with the name Frederiksen ranked high in various European societies as kings, rulers, or leaders, emphasizing power, authority, and control.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christianity, the name Frederiksen is associated with St. Frederick, the patron saint of brewers and the all-important saint for beer-producing communities. It is believed that St. Frederick created a purifying spring in the town of Andechs, Germany, where pilgrims came to drink from the miraculous spring and brew beer. The spiritual significance of the name Frederiksen evokes thoughts of purity, nourishment, and spiritual growth in the context of Christianity.
